Reproducible

Bicep declares infrastructure. GitHub Actions tests code and deploys containers using federated identity.

Controlled access

The pipeline identity can publish data. The API identity can only read it. Storage account keys are disabled.

Recoverable

Failed validation leaves the last release intact. Immutable snapshots support rollback; a lease serializes cloud writers.

Observable

Structured pipeline logs and Application Insights telemetry support investigation. Costs are measured separately.

Observed data release

These are measurements from the release build. They do not represent Azure uptime, cloud performance or cost.

How to interpret this analysis

Unit of analysis

A zoom-16 tile, connection type and quarter. Map points represent tile centroids. Speed measurements are converted from kbps to Mbps by dividing by 1,000.

Weighted metrics

Regional means use each tile's test count as its weight. They describe recorded tests, not average households. Distinct device counts are never summed across tiles.

Comparable change

The matched-tile statistic compares tiles meeting the selected test threshold in both quarters, giving each tile equal weight. Test participants can still change.

Data quality

Every source partition must be non-empty and pass schema, coordinate, uniqueness, finite-value and count checks before publication. Row totals reconcile with SQL storage.
